recommendedTextbook.title: Cultural and Creative Arts for Junior Secondary Schools Book 1
recommendedTextbook.author: I. N. C. Aniekwe, S. O. Babalola
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Introduction to Cultural and Creative Arts (Visual and Performing Arts)
subtopics: Definition and branches of CCA: Visual arts (fine arts, applied arts) and performing arts (drama, dance, music)
Historical role of art in Nigerian traditional societies (court regalia, rituals, domestic utensils)
Career paths: Sculptors, painters, graphic designers, choreographers, music producers, playwrights
objectives: Define Cultural and Creative Arts comprehensively
Differentiate fine arts from applied industrial crafts
List 5 contemporary career opportunities in the Nigerian creative industry

topics.topic: Elements and Principles of Design in Visual Art
subtopics: Elements of design: Line, shape, form, color, value, texture, space
Principles of design: Balance (symmetrical, asymmetrical), proportion, rhythm, harmony, contrast, unity
Practical sketches illustrating lines, tonal gradations, and geometric shapes
objectives: Identify all 7 elements of art in a classical African painting
Explain the difference between symmetrical and asymmetrical visual balance
Draw a tonal value scale showing 5 values from pure white to deepest graphite black

topics.topic: Color Theory and the Color Wheel
subtopics: Primary colors (Red, Yellow, Blue) and secondary colors (Orange, Green, Violet)
Tertiary colors, complementary colors, warm colors vs cool colors
Color mixing demonstration: Pigment behavior and painting simple geometric objects
objectives: Construct a 12-hue artist color wheel using poster paints
Identify pairs of complementary colors that produce high visual contrast
Mix secondary colors from primary pigments without muddiness

topics.topic: Introduction to Music: Staff Notation and Musical Clefs
subtopics: Definition of music and properties of sound (pitch, duration, intensity, timbre)
The musical staff/stave: 5 lines and 4 spaces, ledger lines
Clefs: Treble clef (G-clef) and Bass clef (F-clef), letter names of lines and spaces (EGBDF, FACE)
objectives: Define music and explain the 4 physical properties of sound
Draw a neat Treble clef on a 5-line musical stave
Identify musical pitch notes placed on lines and in spaces of the treble staff
